==Errors==
# [[Shaiel]] entering the battle pregnant did not break "her commander's ban". It broke [[Aiel law]] and custom.
# [[Shaiel]] was dead when [[Tam]] found her. The idea that she was alive likely comes from the {{TVlink|Shaiel|TV show's}} {{TVlink|The Dark Along the Ways|depiction}}. But considering that there are many book-accurate points in these videos that contradict the show, one would think the video creators would want to prioritize consistency with the books over consistency with the show.

==Nitpicks==
# [[Luc]] (and [[Gawyn]]) were [[First Prince of the Sword|First Princes of the Sword]], not "First Sword Princes."
# [[Elayne]] is spelled with a Y, not an I.
# The description of [[Malkier]] as bordering the [[Blight]] on three sides is roughly accurate, but a somewhat odd description given Malkier's shape. The "west" of Malkier isn't a particularly meaningful term, since it contains both the Blight and other Borderlands. The map shown shows the Waste to the east. The Blight is to the north and [[Shienar]] is to the south.
# The [[Aiel#Sharing of water|water-sharing]] occurred during the [[Aiel|Aiel's]] wandering before they settled the [[Aiel Waste|Waste]]. But considering that they outnumbered the Jenn by that point, far enough time and generations had passed to make dating the event to the [[Breaking of the World|Breaking]] somewhat unlikely.
# The [[Aiel Waste]] is often referred to as "The Three-Fold Land" but never as "the land of Three Folds".
# The Blood Snow was called the [[Battle of the Shining Walls]], not "Shimmering" Walls.
# "Accepted ones" is a weird phrasing. They'd just be called "[[Accepted]]."
